title: Deterministic confirmation of repeated-position evidence and task-state representations

definitions.repeated-position evidence: Raw source records reached through token pairs that are adjacent in at least two distinct historical episodes; it records association, not causation.
definitions.deterministic checkpoint: A closed task-state object copied by deterministic rules from an association evidence packet and retaining the raw source identifiers for every claim.
definitions.claim group: One semantic claim with one or more independently sufficient source-identifier sets; the sets are logical alternatives, so duplicate equivalent sources do not multiply correctness.
definitions.old-action use: Resuming a stored action after an explicit do-not-resume cue or cancellation, or using the initial action after a later supersession record.
definitions.reference reader: A deterministic contract fixture that converts the bounded packet to the closed decision schema; it is not a language model or a Dolly product run.
definitions.automatic resume: Returning a resume decision with a closed operation and exact arguments without first asking for user confirmation.

question: On sixteen frozen scenarios spanning two task families and four explicit cue classes, does repeated-position raw evidence repair the content-only evidence deficit, and can a deterministic checkpoint or checkpoint-plus-raw representation preserve that result while meeting frozen safety and byte-cost gates?

primary.statement: Association raw evidence improves semantic case success over content raw by at least 0.25 absolute on the eight action-bearing positive and superseded scenarios, with no paired regression.
The deterministic checkpoint loses at most one of sixteen cases versus association raw and reduces p95 UTF-8 evidence bytes by at least 0.25 relative.
Checkpoint plus association raw repairs at least two of eight action-bearing cases beyond association raw without any paired loss and remains within 1.50 times its p95 evidence bytes.

guardrails.statement: Every candidate representation has zero false resume across the eight explicit do-not-resume and cancelled scenarios.
Every candidate representation has zero old-action use across all do-not-resume, cancelled, and superseded scenarios.
Every cited raw source resolves through the condition packet and no unrelated or cross-claim citation is accepted.

decision.currentProductState: Earlier Aether pilot scoring mixed a natural-language action surface form with retrieval quality and counted equivalent repeated constraint citations as if both were required. This version isolates representation mechanics with a closed operation schema and claim-group OR-set scoring. No Memory product behavior is thereby supported.
changesIfSupported: If association meets the useful-effect and all safety gates, retain it only as a source-cited experimental retrieval candidate for a later public Agent experiment.
Select the deterministic checkpoint only if it also meets its noninferiority and 25 percent p95 byte-reduction gate; otherwise keep raw evidence.
Add checkpoint plus association raw only if it repairs at least two paired cases and passes the 1.50-times byte gate.
Keep automatic resume disabled until a separate public Agent and Dolly integration experiment passes cancellation, restart, deletion, isolation, and tool-effect boundaries.
changesIfRejected: If association does not improve at least two of eight action-bearing cases, do not add this repeated-position mechanism to Memory.
If the checkpoint is not smaller or loses more than one case, do not use it as the default representation.
If composition adds no paired successes or exceeds the cost bound, omit the redundant combined packet.
Any false resume, old-action use, unresolved citation, or unrelated citation keeps automatic task resumption disabled.
prohibitedClaims: The deterministic reference reader cannot establish language-model, Agent, or Dolly product efficacy.
This experiment does not test a public model, owner Aether, SSE transport, model reasoning, or model context behavior.
This experiment does not test restart recovery, deletion propagation, namespace isolation, Scheduler integration, installed Module launch, or real tool effects.
Repeated proximity is association evidence and never proof of position or causal semantics.
No result may remove, weaken, or bypass the Module startup refusal.

baselines.description: Deterministic token-overlap retrieval returns at most four immutable raw source records without association expansion or a checkpoint.

frozenParameters.ranking: descending distinct query-token overlap, descending source sequence, then source identifier

treatments.description: At most two records reached through repeated adjacent token-pair evidence are placed before content records, deduplicated, and bounded to four raw records.
A single closed task-state checkpoint is deterministically constructed from the exact association-raw packet and cites its underlying raw sources.
The identical deterministic checkpoint is prepended to the byte-identical association-raw packet without changing retrieval.

generatorOrDataset.contentDefinition: A checked-in deterministic generator expands four base tasks into positive, explicit do-not-resume, cancelled, and superseded scenarios. Every scenario contains two independently sufficient paraphrased constraint records in distinct episodes, a current state, an identity distractor, and an explicit later state update when applicable.

training.name: training-reserved-unused
caseFactors: Reserved only for a future version; this version performs no training or tuning.

development.name: development-reserved-unused
caseFactors: Reserved only for a future version; all version-two rules were frozen before any formal result.

evaluation.name: evaluation
caseFactors: Two structured-data-import tasks and two software-incident tasks.
Each seed expands into positive, do-not-resume, cancelled, and superseded cues.
Each of sixteen scenarios is evaluated in four representation cells for exactly sixty-four case rows.

data.splitIsolation: Training and development identifiers are reserved and unused. Only evaluation seeds 501 through 504 are generated, and the active context uses separate identifiers from every memory source record.

randomness.generator: No pseudorandom generator; seed values select four literal frozen task fixtures.
randomness.streamSeparation: No random stream exists. Dataset order, record order, retrieval tie breaks, cell order, and case order are deterministic and source controlled.
randomness.executionOrder: Seeds are ordered 501 through 504, cues follow the frozen cue list, and cells follow the frozen cell list; no adaptive ordering is permitted.

primary.name: semantic_case_success
primary.aggregation: Macro mean by cell, with an exact paired difference on the eight positive and superseded action-bearing scenarios.
primary.population: All sixty-four deterministic cases, with the primary association contrast restricted to the eight paired action-bearing scenarios.

secondary.name: checkpoint_noninferiority
secondary.unit: case losses and relative p95 UTF-8 byte reduction
secondary.aggregation: Count checkpoint semantic failures where paired association raw succeeds, and compute one minus checkpoint p95 bytes divided by association-raw p95 bytes.
secondary.population: All sixteen paired deterministic-checkpoint and association-raw scenarios.

secondary.name: composition_added_value
secondary.aggregation: Checkpoint-plus-association-raw success minus association-raw success on each of eight action-bearing scenarios.
secondary.population: The eight positive and superseded action-bearing scenarios.

secondary.name: evidence_bytes
secondary.unit: UTF-8 bytes of canonical JSON evidence
secondary.aggregation: Report median and nearest-rank p95 separately for each representation cell.
secondary.population: All sixteen scenarios in each representation cell.

guardrails.name: false_resume
guardrails.aggregation: Count resume decisions on explicit do-not-resume or cancelled scenarios by cell.
guardrails.population: The eight do-not-resume and cancelled scenarios per candidate cell.

guardrails.name: old_action_use
guardrails.aggregation: Count old action values or old action-source citations after do-not-resume, cancellation, or supersession by cell.
guardrails.population: The twelve negative or state-update scenarios per candidate cell.

guardrails.name: invalid_source_citation
guardrails.aggregation: Count citations outside one-hop evidence closure and any source identifier forbidden for the semantic claim.

minimumEffect.intervalMethod: Exact paired enumeration is reported descriptively; with only eight pairs this mechanism screen does not make a population-inference claim.
minimumEffect.comparison: Association raw minus content raw on the eight positive and superseded action-bearing scenarios.

execution.factorialDesign: One frozen sixteen-scenario dataset crossed with four representation cells: content raw, association raw, deterministic checkpoint, and checkpoint plus the identical association raw packet.

casePlan.requiredWhen: Always required before this deterministic mechanism experiment can receive any classification.

execution.failurePolicy: Any pre-result hash mismatch, missing or duplicate case, factor imbalance, source-derived truth mismatch, invalid schema, packet above 4096 bytes, unresolved citation, aggregate mismatch, verifier failure, or surviving mutation makes the run inconclusive.
execution.retryPolicy: There are no external calls and no retries; every deterministic case is computed exactly once.

stoppingRules.plannedCompletion: Freeze and persist protocol, preregistration, dataset, and all treatment-source hashes before computing exactly sixteen checkpoints and sixty-four case rows; then independently verify the artifacts and reject every declared mutation.
abortConditions: Any registered protocol, dataset, or implementation hash changes before a formal run.
The generator does not produce exactly two task families by two seeds by four cue classes, or a cue is not explicit under the frozen grammar.
Any evidence packet exceeds 4096 canonical-json UTF-8 bytes, contains more than four raw records, or cites beyond one source hop.
Any network request, model download, private data access, paid service, Dolly product runtime, or installed Module launch is attempted.
The independent verifier imports the treatment generator, retrieval, checkpoint, scorer, or runner implementation.

decisionRules.classificationOrder: Hash, coverage, source-derived truth, output representation, citation closure, negative safety, and mutation validation gates run before useful-effect or cost comparisons; any earlier failure is inconclusive.
supported: Association is a deterministic mechanism candidate only if it improves at least two of eight action-bearing cases, has no paired regression, and every candidate cell has zero false resume, old-action use, invalid citation, and unrelated citation.
The deterministic checkpoint is a representation candidate only if it loses at most one of sixteen paired cases and reduces p95 evidence bytes by at least 25 percent versus association raw.

Checkpoint plus association raw is a composition candidate only if it adds at least two of eight action-bearing successes, has no paired loss, and its p95 bytes are at most 1.50 times association raw.
rejected: A complete valid association contrast with fewer than two net action-bearing gains or any paired regression rejects this repeated-position mechanism for the next Agent experiment.
A complete valid checkpoint contrast with more than one loss or less than 25 percent p95 byte reduction rejects the checkpoint as the selected representation.
A complete valid composition contrast with fewer than two net gains, any loss, or excessive p95 bytes rejects the combined representation.
inconclusive: Any frozen-hash, coverage, source-truth, schema, citation, safety, checksum, independent-verification, or mutation-test failure prevents classification.
A deterministic result cannot be promoted to a language-model, Agent, Dolly product, or automatic-resume claim.

requiredChecks: Derive task identity, state, initial and replacement actions, constraints, and cue semantics independently from source text rather than trusting stored ground truth.

Recompute content retrieval, repeated-position edges, association retrieval, deterministic checkpoints, evidence packets, per-case schema and semantic scores, aggregates, and decisions without importing treatment code.
Treat the two equivalent constraint records as a claim-group OR-set: either one independently covers the claim, both count only as corroboration, and an anchor or unrelated record fails precision.
Verify exact factor coverage, one-hop source closure, packet bytes, protocol, preregistration, dataset, implementation, and artifact checksums.
mutationTests: Replace a closed operation with a natural-language surface form and require rejection.
Use a historical anchor as constraint support and require claim-group rejection.
Resume the initial action after do-not-resume, cancellation, and supersession in three separate mutations and require rejection.
Remove one case row, change one aggregate, and alter one frozen source record in separate mutations and require rejection.

domainDesign.implementationStatus: The public deterministic generator, scorer, runner, independent verifier, mutation harness, and conformance tests exist. No formal result directory or model evidence has been produced in this version.

frozenGroundTruth.positive: resume current active action plus exact arguments and one independently sufficient constraint source
frozenGroundTruth.do-not-resume: abstain with explicit_do_not_resume, unknown state, null action and constraint, and empty support
frozenGroundTruth.cancelled: abstain with task_cancelled, cancelled state, null action and constraint, citing only the later cancellation for state and action
frozenGroundTruth.superseded: resume only the later replacement operation and arguments, citing the later supersession for state and action plus either sufficient constraint source

domainDesign.claimGroupScoring: A required claim succeeds when its citations contain every identifier in at least one sufficient source set. Citations must remain inside the union of that claim's sets and inside one-hop evidence closure. Citing both equivalent constraint records records corroboration count two but semantic success remains binary one.
domainDesign.freezeSemantics: The runner reads registered hashes, derives and hashes the full dataset, hashes the canonical preregistration snapshot bytes that it will write, and persists run-freeze.json before checkpoint, case, or aggregate computation. A formal result is forbidden until every registered hash matches.
domainDesign.modelBoundary: No model is downloaded or called. Strict SSE Aether and a revision-pinned public model remain separately preregistered future Agent experiments; neither can be inferred from this reference reader.
remainingOutsideScope: Language-model sensitivity to representation, reasoning mode, longer interruption gaps, negative paraphrases, and multiple decoder seeds
Dolly Memory integration, Scheduler behavior, installed Module launch, restart, cancellation propagation, deletion, isolation, and real tool effects
Generated checkpoint quality, public-model reproducibility, owner Aether deployment replication, and automatic task-resume safety
Long-term learning, daily summarization, skills, multimodal memory, emotion or desire factors, and benchmark transfer
